build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
create_convex_polygon: create a convex polygon in the PHYRE scene using C.add_convex_polygon with vertex coordinates
add_container: add a container object to the PHYRE scene using vt.add_container with goal vertices
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene using C.add with radius and center position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task goal using C.update_task with body1, body2, and spatial relationships
